scripts.assets:vegetation: .venv-blender/bin/python scripts/blender/build_vegetation.py && gltf-transform resize public/models/vegetation/vegetation.glb public/models/vegetation/vegetation.glb --width 512 --height 512 && gltf-transform webp public/models/vegetation/vegetation.glb public/models/vegetation/vegetation.glb --quality 82 && node scripts/optimize-glb.mjs
scripts.assets:cliffs: .venv-blender/bin/python scripts/blender/build_cliffs.py && gltf-transform resize public/models/cliffs/cliffs.glb public/models/cliffs/cliffs.glb --width 1024 --height 1024 && gltf-transform webp public/models/cliffs/cliffs.glb public/models/cliffs/cliffs.glb --quality 80 && node scripts/optimize-glb.mjs
scripts.assets:props: .venv-blender/bin/python scripts/blender/build_props.py && gltf-transform resize public/models/props/props.glb public/models/props/props.glb --width 512 --height 512 && gltf-transform webp public/models/props/props.glb public/models/props/props.glb --quality 82 && node scripts/optimize-glb.mjs
scripts.assets: npm run assets:blender && npm run assets:optimize
